final: WITH group_counts AS (SELECT p.throws, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM manager_award AS m JOIN player AS p ON m.player_id COLLATE BINARY = p.player_id COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY p.throws), totals AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM group_counts), shares AS (SELECT g.throws, g.record_count, CAST(g.record_count AS REAL) / t.total_count AS share FROM group_counts AS g JOIN totals AS t ON t.total_count IS NOT NULL), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares), kept AS (SELECT s.record_count, s.share, a.avg_share FROM shares AS s JOIN average_share AS a ON a.avg_share IS NOT NULL WHERE s.share > a.avg_share) SELECT SUM(record_count), AVG(share), AVG(share - avg_share) FROM kept
